description: Find exact dollar amounts where one more cent of an input costs MORE than a cent of tax (marginal rate over 100%) — e.g. the EITC investment-income kill switch, CTC phase-out steps. Every probe is a real evaluation.

facts.description: facts for the computation: either flat corpus fact ids (see list_input_facts) or the same group objects calculate_tax accepts (filing, income, retirement, …), plus optional target and asOf. Business/fiduciary/dependent facts are accepted flat. Unknown keys are rejected by name — nothing is ever silently dropped.

vary.description: money fact to vary, e.g. "wages" or "taxableInterest"

name: find_tax_cliffs
